description: This file defines the `CacheLookupContext` interface, providing methods to access optional DittoHeaders and JsonFieldSelector objects used as additional context in cache lookup operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: CacheLookupContext
classes.description: An interface that provides optional DittoHeaders and JsonFieldSelector for cache lookup operations, adding context for caching key resolution.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing DittoHeaders provided in this context, if any.

methods.name: getJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing JsonFieldSelector provided in this context, if any.
